title: Mang Den plateau day
summary: Dak Ke lake while the mist is still on the water, then Kon Pring village for the afternoon. Add Pa Sy, about 9 km from town, if you want the waterfall too, and end with grilled chicken and lam rice back in town.

stops.name: Dak Ke Lake
stops.note: Walk the shore while the air is still cool, and take a canoe out if one is running.

stops.name: Kon Pring village
stops.note: Communal house and gongs on Highway 24. Ask before you photograph inside the nhà rông.

seoTitle: One day on the Mang Den plateau
seoDescription: A Mang Den day: Dak Ke lake in the morning mist, Kon Pring village in the afternoon, and Pa Sy waterfall, about 9 km from town, if you want the fall.
